scope: Coverage-completion fact-check of current-holding dossiers never previously independently audited: BR, CMCSA, BKNG, DG, NOW, BX, EG (7 dossiers, 4 load-bearing facts each = 28 facts total). Facts were selected to prioritize the claims most likely to be wrong: adjusted-vs-GAAP splits, fiscal-period/date labels, guidance deltas, and deal/litigation status as of 2026-09-25. One fact (NOW / Moveworks) was a specifically flagged known issue: a Loop-3 auditor found the dossier's 'still under DOJ review, not closed' characterization was stale and that the deal closed around Dec 2025.

facts.claim: FY2026 total revenue $7,476.8m (+8.5%); diluted EPS $9.60 (GAAP) = Adjusted EPS $9.60 (+12%) -- an unusual GAAP/adjusted convergence the dossier flags as unresolved
facts.dossier_location: BR.md §4 results table + §11 red-flag scan ('Data conflict, disclosed, unresolved')
facts.source: Broadridge 8-K Ex-99.1, Q4/FY2026 results, accession 0001383312-26-000022, filed 2026-08-04 ('Broadridge Reports Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Results')
facts.source_value: "Diluted EPS was $9.60 and Adjusted EPS grew 12% to $9.60"; Total revenues FY2026 $7,477m (+9% as reported; dossier's +8.5% is the recurring-revenue-basis figure, also stated in the release as 'Recurring revenues grew 8%')
facts.note: Exact match, including the odd GAAP=adjusted coincidence -- this is genuinely what the company reported, not a dossier transcription error.

facts.claim: CQG acquisition (futures/options execution and market connectivity) completed 1 May 2026; deal size not disclosed by the company
facts.dossier_location: BR.md §2 ('completed 1 May 2026'), §6 ('deal size not disclosed'), §11 ('financial terms undisclosed by the company... lack of disclosed purchase price is itself noted for completeness')
facts.source: Broadridge 8-K Ex-99.1, Q3 FY2026 results, accession 0001383312-26-000013, filed 2026-04-30, 'Subsequent Event' note
facts.source_value: "On April 30, 2026, the Company completed the acquisition of CQG, Inc. ... The total purchase price was approximately $173 million plus additional contingent consideration."
facts.note: Two errors: (1) the dossier's completion date (1 May 2026) is one day off the company's own primary-source date (April 30, 2026 -- likely inherited from a press-release dateline rather than the SEC filing); (2) the dossier states twice, as a named data gap, that the purchase price is undisclosed, but Broadridge's own 8-K explicitly discloses a total purchase price of approximately $173 million plus contingent consideration. This is a load-bearing miss because the dossier's M&A-materiality discussion (§6, §11) is built on the premise that no price was ever given.

facts.claim: Shareholder securities class action (Washtenaw County v. Dollar General): court granted defendants' motion to dismiss the second consolidated amended complaint without prejudice on 2026-06-23; lead plaintiffs filed a motion for leave to amend on 2025-08-25; 'status as of this dossier: dismissed but not fully resolved -- monitor'
facts.dossier_location: DG.md §9 kill criterion 5, §10 catalysts ('any ruling on the pending motion for leave to amend'), §11 red-flag scan
facts.source: Dollar General Q2 FY2026 10-Q, accession 0001104659-26-101932, filed 2026-08-27, Legal Proceedings note
facts.source_value: Dismissal without prejudice of the second amended complaint occurred on **June 23, 2025** (one year earlier than the dossier's 2026-06-23). The motion for leave to amend was already **granted on March 24, 2026**, and lead plaintiffs then filed a **third** consolidated amended complaint; defendants moved to dismiss that third complaint on April 21, 2026, with briefing completed May 29, 2026 -- i.e. a fully-briefed motion to dismiss the third complaint is what is actually pending, not a motion for leave to amend. The litigation is also two consolidated matters (Washtenaw County + Edmonds, the latter voluntarily dismissed Jan 2024), not one.
facts.note: The dossier's dismissal date is off by exactly one year (2026-06-23 vs the filing's 2025-06-23), and its 'status as of this dossier' materially understates how far the case has progressed: as of DG's own most-recently-cited 10-Q, a THIRD amended complaint has been filed and a fully-briefed motion to dismiss it is pending -- not an open motion for leave to amend. This affects both a kill criterion and a listed forward catalyst.
